name: Border
description: A border around the photo in Develop, drawn inside the frame so the photo keeps its size. Visible in Develop, on thumbnails, in presets and in every export.
author: OPGERUIMD97

commands.name: border
commands.summary: Apply, remove or inspect the border on the open photo or the Library selection

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.summary: Say which border each photo has

subcommands.name: apply
subcommands.summary: Apply a template, or the default when no name is given

subcommands.name: set
subcommands.summary: Set the border from size= and other settings

subcommands.name: export
subcommands.summary: Export the photos with the export defaults. Also a word after apply, set or off
